next_step: Complete 2-week Hosted API POC (streaming + tool-calling) -> measure 95th percentile latency; follow-up pricing for Dedicated pools
notes: Mid-market B2B SaaS (customer engagement platform) exploring adding agentic assistants for customer support and in-product workflow automation. Primary ask: low-latency streaming chat for human-facing assistant + reliable multi-step tool chains (search -> action -> update). Concern: tool-call orchestration timeouts and how Redwood handles partial failures/compensating actions. Prefer Hosted API for quick POC; pricing conversation will move to Dedicated if latency/cost profile justifies reserved capacity. Security: need SSO/SAML, audit logs, and explicit data residency for EU customers they serve. AE/SE conversations ongoing. Quote from CTO: 'We need sub-500ms turn token latency in happy path for streaming or users will feel lag - tool calls are the biggest unknown.'

use_case_summary: Build an in-product assistant that executes multi-step tasks: search knowledge base, call downstream product APIs (create ticket, trigger email), and summarize results for the user. Must support streaming responses to show progress and early results, and provide deterministic rollback/compensation for failed tool steps.
poc_requirements: Validate 95th percentile token streaming latency <= 500ms for typical user sessions
Test tool-calling reliability under mixed load (search + 3rd-party API calls)
Demonstrate graceful degradation: fallback to lighter model variant if tail latency spikes
Collect token-level cost and latency breakdowns per route
End-to-end logs for audit + replay for failed flows
decision_criteria: Meets latency SLOs under expected QPS
Tool-call reliability & retry semantics documented and tested
Predictable unit economics (cost per active agent) - ability to reduce cost via batching/caching
Security/compliance signoffs (SAML, audit logs, data residency)
Clear path for Dedicated capacity pricing and SLA
